info.title: HostAfricaApi
info.description:
HostAfrica’s Public API provides reliable, programmatic control over VPS services with a broad set of industry-standard API developer tools. 
As well as a RESTful API we provide a CLI and SDKs for a variety of languages as automation building blocks and a streamable MCP server for agent-driven, context-aware automation.

## Authentication
Authentication is token-based and all endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <your-token>
```


API base URL is https://api.hostafrica.com/

## Token generation
You can obtain a token for the API by logging into https://hcode.hostafrica.com with your HostAfrica account.
The token will have the same privileges as the owning client. You can also rotate or revoke a token at any time in the same section.

## Rate Limiting
The number of requests to the API per time period is limited. If you exceed this limit you will receive a `429 Too Many Requests` error.
Our provided SDKs and CLI will automatically retry certain requests and these settings can be overridden.
Your IP address may get temporarily blocked if you exceed the rate limit too often.

## Error Handling
Standard HTTP status code responses are returned for requests and the JSON response body contains human-readable messages for both successful and failed requests. 

## Developer Tools
We provide repositories with SDKs and code examples for a variety of languages, a CLI and a streamble MCP server.
- CLI: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-cli
- Node/TypeScript: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-typescript
- Python: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-python
- Go: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-go
- PHP: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-php
- Java: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-java (coming soon)
- C#: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-csharp (coming soon)
- Ruby: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-ruby (coming soon)
- Rust: https://github.com/hostafrica/ha-sdk-rust (coming soon)
- Postman collection: https://api.hostafrica.com/docs/hostafrica-api.postman-collection.json

## MCP Server
We provide a streamable MCP server that can be used to interact with the API. The endpoint is https://api.hostafrica.com/mcp and it uses the same authentication mechanism as the API.

## Changelog
We will provide a changelog for the API with each major release.





### Support and Feedback
For questions, bugs and feature requests specifically related to the API please create an issue[link] or discussion[link] on the repository.

For general support and feedback, please contact us at support@hostafrica.com.

tags.name: Backups
tags.description: Create and restore on-demand backups of your VPS instances and configure automated backup schedules to protect your data.

tags.name: Console Access
tags.description: Open an in-browser noVNC console session to your VPS for direct terminal access when SSH is unavailable.

tags.name: DNS
tags.description: Manage reverse DNS (rDNS) records that map IP addresses assigned to your services back to hostnames.

tags.name: Firewall
tags.description: Define and manage inbound and outbound firewall rules for your VPS instances, including rule ordering and priority management.

tags.name: Monitoring
tags.description: Configure notification triggers on resource metrics such as CPU, memory, and disk usage to receive alerts when thresholds are breached.

tags.name: Power Management
tags.description: Control the power state of your VPS instances and schedule automated power tasks. Start, stop, reboot, or gracefully shut down a VPS, and create or manage recurring power schedules.

tags.name: Security
tags.description: Manage OS-level credentials and SSH key access for your VPS instances, including password changes and SSH key rotation.

tags.name: Service Management
tags.description: Browse the service catalogue, validate pricing, place orders, and manage existing subscriptions including cancellation and payment retries.

tags.name: Snapshots
tags.description: Capture point-in-time snapshots of a VPS disk, update snapshot metadata, roll back to a previous snapshot, and delete snapshots you no longer need.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Manage account-level user settings such as updating the password for the authenticated user.

tags.name: VPS Management
tags.description: Manage your VPS instances — list services, retrieve configuration details, update settings, mount ISO images, and reinstall the operating system.
